children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may test resistance at $7.38-1/4 per bushel, a break above which could lead to a gain into the $7.47-1/2 to $7.53-1/4 range.
The market is stabilizing around support at $7.23, identified as the 61.8% projection level of wave c from $7.62-1/2.
This wave may either end around the support or extend to $6.98-1/2. Considering that wave c could be broken down into five smaller waves, it might be complete.
The peak of wave iv around $7.38-1/4 serves as the initial target. A break below $7.23 would confirm the extension of wave c toward $6.98-1/2.

The break will be valid when the market falls to $7.18. On the daily chart, a rising channel suggests limited downside, as the channel line establishes support around $7.05, forming a support zone with the higher support of $7.13-3/4 to stop a further fall.
